origin: The name of the design language Apple introduced across its operating systems, including iOS 26, in 2025.
whenToUse: Control bars floating over photos or video.
Layering controls without covering the content.
Matching the look of the latest platforms.
whenNotToUse: Long text over bright, busy backgrounds.
Overusing heavy filters to imitate refraction on the web.
Screens where contrast can't be guaranteed.
accessibility: Check text shadow and contrast together so text stays readable when the background changes.
With prefers-reduced-transparency, switching to opaque surfaces is recommended.
The reflection layer is pointer-events: none decoration.
